# Data Extraction

RRF reference data are sourced from the US FDA Chemicals List for Analytical Performance (CLAP) — <https://cdrh-rst.fda.gov/chemicals-list-analytical-performance-clap>. Three datasets (GC/MS, LC/MS positive-ion, LC/MS negative-ion) were extracted from the corresponding PDFs and stored as Excel workbooks. Non-detected values were set to 0 and values reported as below the detection limit were set to 0.001, following Subject Matter Expert (SME) guidance. All three datasets are loaded in every simulation file to maintain cross-technique comparability; only the dataset relevant to this scenario is sampled in the Monte Carlo loop.

```{r}
#| message: false
# ── GC/MS RRF data (CLAP) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Source: RRF GCMS for CLAP.pdf  →  processed_data/GCMS.xlsx  (sheet "GC-MS")
gcms_clap       <- read_excel(path = "../../data/processed/CLAP_GCMS_clean.xlsx", sheet = "GC-MS")
gcms_clap_clean <- gcms_clap %>% na.omit()
gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL"  <- as.numeric(gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL")
gcms_clap_clean$"10 µg/mL" <- as.numeric(gcms_clap_clean$"10 µg/mL")
gcms_clap_clean$"20 µg/mL" <- as.numeric(gcms_clap_clean$"20 µg/mL")

# ── LC/MS positive-ion RRF data (CLAP) ─────────────────────────────────────
# Source: LCMS RRFs CLAP Positive Ion Detection.pdf  →  processed_data/LCMS.xlsx  (sheet "LCMSPOS")
lcmspos_clap       <- read_excel(path = "../../data/processed/CLAP_LCMS_clean.xlsx", sheet = "LCMSPOS")
lcmspos_clap_clean <- lcmspos_clap %>% na.omit()

# ── LC/MS negative-ion RRF data (CLAP) ─────────────────────────────────────
# Source: LCMS RRFs CLAP Negative Ion Detection.pdf  →  processed_data/LCMS.xlsx  (sheet "LCMSNEG")
lcmsneg_clap       <- read_excel(path = "../../data/processed/CLAP_LCMS_clean.xlsx", sheet = "LCMSNEG")
lcmsneg_clap_clean <- lcmsneg_clap %>% na.omit()

# Dataset size check — critical for bootstrap validity (see Reproducibility notes below).
# Each simulation iteration draws N_extractables = 80 compounds WITHOUT replacement;
# the relevant column must contain at least 80 non-missing entries.
cat(sprintf("GC/MS:   %d compounds (3 surrogate concentrations)\n", nrow(gcms_clap_clean)))
cat(sprintf("LC/MS+:  %d compounds (3 surrogate concentrations)\n", nrow(lcmspos_clap_clean)))
cat(sprintf("LC/MS-:  %d compounds (3 surrogate concentrations)\n", nrow(lcmsneg_clap_clean)))
```

# Simulation parameters

```{r}
# Analytical Evaluation Threshold (AET) in µg/mL (or µg/g depending on sample preparation).
# Root-level files use AET = 3 µg/mL as the reference value.
# Sensitivity analyses at AET = 0.45, 3, 6, and 36 µg/mL are available in
# the sub-folders 3_Results/AET <value>/.
AET <- 0.45
```

## Fitted RRF distribution (required for this scenario)

This scenario uses a gamma distribution fitted by **censored maximum likelihood** to the LC/MS negative-ion CLAP RRF data (5 µg/mL surrogate), following the same Turnbull NPMLE approach used in `Pooled_concentration_distributions.qmd` for the extractables concentration data. Values equal to 0 (non-detected) and 0.001 (below detection limit) are treated as left-censored at the instrument LOQ (0.001 RRF units) rather than excluded or substituted, which avoids biasing the parameter estimates downward.

```{r}
# ── Censored data frame for the CLAP LC/MS– RRF data (5 µg/mL surrogate) ────
# Convention (Turnbull, 1976; fitdistrplus documentation):
#   Detected observation  →  left = right = observed RRF value  (exact)
#   N.D. / below-DL value →  left = NA,   right = LOQ          (left-censored)
#
# The LOQ in RRF units is taken as 0.001 (the value assigned to below-DL entries
# during pre-processing; n.d. entries were set to 0, also below this threshold).
rrf_raw  <- as.numeric(lcmsneg_clap$"5 µg/mL")
loq_rrf  <- 0.001

rrf_cens <- data.frame(
  left  = ifelse(rrf_raw <= loq_rrf, NA,       rrf_raw),
  right = ifelse(rrf_raw <= loq_rrf, loq_rrf,  rrf_raw)
)

set.seed(123)
fit_rrf_gamma <- fitdistcens(rrf_cens, "gamma")
gamma_shape   <- fit_rrf_gamma$estimate["shape"]
gamma_rate    <- fit_rrf_gamma$estimate["rate"]
cat(sprintf("Fitted gamma (censored MLE):  shape = %.4f,  rate = %.4f\n",
            gamma_shape, gamma_rate))
```

# Scenario: Log-Normal Concentration Distribution (LC/MS-Fitted: $\mu=-2.4$, $\sigma=4.8$) with Empirical LC/MS (negative ion) RRFs (5 µg/mL Surrogate)

This notebook presents Monte Carlo simulation results quantifying the classification bias introduced by Relative Response Factors (RRFs) in LC/MS (negative ion) extractables and leachables (E&L) studies. In each iteration, 80 hypothetical extractable compounds are drawn from a chosen concentration distribution, their measured concentrations are distorted by an RRF, and each compound is classified as at or above / below the Analytical Evaluation Threshold (AET). Several uncertainty-factor (UF) correction strategies are then evaluated against the baseline (no correction) using standard classification metrics.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Simulation design

| Parameter | Value |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| **Analytical technique** | LC/MS (negative ion) |
| **Surrogate concentration** | **5 µg/mL** |
| **Concentration distribution (Conc ID 2)** | Log-Normal fitted from an actual **LC/MS** extractables study ($\mu_{\log} = -2.4$, $\sigma_{\log} = 4.8$); represents a realistic, study-derived concentration distribution. |
| **RRF distribution (RRF ID A)** | Empirical — non-parametric bootstrap (sampling without replacement) from the LC/MS negative-ion section of the US FDA CLAP list, at a surrogate concentration of **5 µg/mL**. This approach preserves the real-world dispersion of detector response factors. |
| **AET** | 3 µg/mL (or µg/g) |
| **Iterations** (`N_sim`) | 10,000 |
| **Compounds per iteration** (`N_extractables`) | 80 |
| **Correction strategies** | No correction; UF = 2; UF = 4; UF = 10; UF(RSD); UF(RSD, filtered); UF(mean·RSD, filtered); UF(mean·RSD) |
| **Performance metrics** | FNR, FPR, F₁, F_β (β = 5), MCC, DOR |

The UF formulas follow ISO 10993-18. The **False Negative Rate (FNR)** quantifies under-reporting risk (compounds truly ≥ AET that are missed), while the **False Positive Rate (FPR)** quantifies over-reporting. The **Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC)** and **F_β score** (β = 5, strongly favouring recall) are used as balanced overall performance indicators.
:::

## Initialisation of the comparison table

```{r}
summary_table <- data.frame(
  Method = character(),
  FN_Rate = numeric(),
  FP_Rate = numeric(),
  FN_SD = numeric(),
  FP_SD = numeric(),
  precision = numeric(),
  recall = numeric(),
  F1 = numeric(),
  f_beta = numeric(),
  MCC = numeric(),
  DOR = numeric()
)

all_distributions <- data.frame()
```

## Baseline: No RRF Correction

```{r}
set.seed(123)
N_sim <- 10000
dist_MCC <- numeric(N_sim)
dist_DOR <- numeric(N_sim)
N_extractables <- 80
total_FN <- 0
total_FP <- 0
total_TP <- 0
total_TN <- 0
dist_f1 <- numeric(N_sim)
dist_f5 <- numeric(N_sim)
dist_fnr <- numeric(N_sim)
dist_fpr <- numeric(N_sim)
beta <- 5

for (i in 1:N_sim) {
## 2) Concentration from the log-normal distribution
base_conc_sim <- rlnorm(N_extractables, meanlog = -2.4, sdlog = 4.8)
## A) Sampling from the GC/MS dataset (5µg/mL)
simulated_RRF <- rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate)
## I) No Correction
corrected_conc <- base_conc_sim * simulated_RRF

is_at_and_above_threshold <- base_conc_sim >= AET
reported_at_and_above_threshold <- corrected_conc >= AET

## Count per iteration
  iter_TP <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FP <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FN <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_TN <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)

  total_TP <- total_TP + iter_TP
  total_FP <- total_FP + iter_FP
  total_FN <- total_FN + iter_FN
  total_TN <- total_TN + iter_TN

  # Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC)
  denom_MCC <- sqrt(as.numeric(iter_TP+iter_FP)*(iter_TP+iter_FN)*(iter_TN+iter_FP)*(iter_TN+iter_FN))
  iter_MCC <- if(denom_MCC > 0) ((as.numeric(iter_TP)*iter_TN) - (as.numeric(iter_FP)*iter_FN)) / denom_MCC else 0
  
  # Diagnostic Odds Ratio (DOR)
  iter_DOR <- (as.numeric(iter_TP) * iter_TN) / ((as.numeric(iter_FP) * iter_FN) + 1e-6)
  
  dist_MCC[i] <- iter_MCC
  dist_DOR[i] <- iter_DOR


  # metrics per iterations
  iter_prec <- if((iter_TP + iter_FP) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FP) else 0
  iter_rec  <- if((iter_TP + iter_FN) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FN) else 0
  
  iter_ActualPos <- iter_TP + iter_FN
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP

  iter_fnr <- if(iter_ActualPos > 0) iter_FN / iter_ActualPos else 0
  iter_fpr <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_FP / iter_ActualNeg else 0
  
  dist_fnr[i] <- iter_fnr * 100
  dist_fpr[i] <- iter_fpr * 100
  
  # F1
  iter_f1 <- if((iter_prec + iter_rec) > 0) {
    (2 * iter_prec * iter_rec) / (iter_prec + iter_rec)
  } else { 0 }
  
  # F5
  denom_beta <- (beta^2 * iter_prec) + iter_rec
  iter_fbeta <- if(denom_beta > 0) {
    ((1 + beta^2) * (iter_prec * iter_rec)) / denom_beta
  } else { 0 }
  
  dist_f1[i]   <- iter_f1
  dist_f5[i]   <- iter_fbeta
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP
  iter_Total     <- iter_TP + iter_FP + iter_FN + iter_TN
  iter_spec      <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_TN / iter_ActualNeg else 0}

count_Above_AET <- total_TP + total_FN
count_Below_AET  <- total_TN + total_FP
FN_Rate_final <- total_FN / count_Above_AET
FP_Rate_final <- total_FP / count_Below_AET

recall <- total_TP / count_Above_AET
precision <- total_TP / (total_TP + total_FP)

F1 <- (2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
beta <- 5
f_beta <- (1 + beta^2) * (precision * recall) / ((beta^2 * precision) + recall)

SD_FN <- sqrt(FN_Rate_final * (1 - FN_Rate_final) / count_Above_AET)
SD_FP <- sqrt(FP_Rate_final * (1 - FP_Rate_final) / count_Below_AET)

summary_table <- bind_rows(
  summary_table,
  data.frame(
    Method = "No Correction",
    FN_Rate = FN_Rate_final,
    FP_Rate = FP_Rate_final,
    FN_SD = SD_FN,
    FP_SD = SD_FP,
    precision = precision,
    recall = recall,
    F1 = F1,
    f_beta = f_beta,MCC = mean(dist_MCC, na.rm = TRUE),
    DOR = mean(dist_DOR, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Absolute Counts and UF
    is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Above_AET,
    X.is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Below_AET,
    reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TP + total_FP,
    X.reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TN + total_FN,
    perc_is_at_and_above_threshold = (count_Above_AET / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    perc_reported_at_and_above_threshold = ((total_TP + total_FP) / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    UF = 1
  )
)

metrics_df <- data.frame(
  Method = "No Correction",
  F1 = dist_f1,
  F5 = dist_f5,
  Percent_FN = dist_fnr,
  Percent_FP = dist_fpr,MCC = dist_MCC,
  DOR = dist_DOR
)

all_distributions <- rbind(all_distributions, metrics_df)

```

```{r}
# 1. Calculate the cumulative mean of the False Negative Rate as simulations progress
convergence_data <- tibble(
  Iteration = 1:N_sim,
  FNR_Current = dist_fnr,
  FNR_Cumulative_Mean = cummean(dist_fnr)
)

# 2. Plot the convergence
ggplot(convergence_data, aes(x = Iteration, y = FNR_Cumulative_Mean)) +
  geom_line(color = "indianred", linewidth = 1) +
  
  # Add a dashed line for the FINAL mean to show what it is converging to
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(dist_fnr, na.rm = TRUE), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  
  # Log scale the X axis so the wild early fluctuations are easier to see
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma) + 
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Convergence of False Negative Rate Estimate",
    x = "Number of simulations (Log Scale)",
    y = "Cumulative Mean False Negative Rate (%)"
  )
```

```{r}
# 1. Calculate the final mean and the Standard Error of the Mean (SEM)
final_mean_fnr <- mean(dist_fnr, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_fnr <- sd(dist_fnr, na.rm = TRUE)
sem_fnr <- sd_fnr / sqrt(N_sim) # Standard Error

# 2. Calculate the 95% Confidence Interval for the MEAN
ci_lower <- final_mean_fnr - (1.96 * sem_fnr)
ci_upper <- final_mean_fnr + (1.96 * sem_fnr)

# 3. Create the Density plot
ggplot(tibble(FNR = dist_fnr), aes(x = FNR)) +
  geom_density(fill = "skyblue", alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +
  
  # Plot the Mean as a solid line
  geom_vline(xintercept = final_mean_fnr, color = "darkred", linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  # Plot the 95% CI bounds as dashed lines (These will be very close together!)
  geom_vline(xintercept = ci_lower, color = "darkred", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = ci_upper, color = "darkred", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of simulated FN rates",
    subtitle = paste0("10,000 Runs | Mean: ", round(final_mean_fnr, 2), 
                      "% | 95% CI: [", round(ci_lower, 2), "%, ", round(ci_upper, 2), "%]"),
    x = "False Negative Rate (%) per Iteration",
    y = "Density"
  )



```

## Uncertainty-Factor (UF) Corrections — ISO 10993-18

```{r}
rsd <- function(x) {
  return(sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# RSD of the filtered RRF dataset (0.05 < RRF ≤ 1) — avoids negative UF from extreme outliers
rsd_filtered <- function(x) {
  x_use = x[x<=1&x>0.05]
  return(sd(x_use, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(x_use, na.rm = TRUE))
}
# Mean of the filtered RRF dataset — used in the extended UF(mean·RSD) formula
mean_filtered <- function(x) {
  x_use <- x[x <= 1 & x > 0.05]
  return(mean(x_use, na.rm = TRUE))
}


set.seed(123)
N_sim <- 10000
dist_MCC <- numeric(N_sim)
dist_DOR <- numeric(N_sim)
UF_RSD <- 1/(1 - rsd(rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate))) # formula from ISO 10993-18
UF_RSD_filtered <- 1/(1 - rsd_filtered(rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate))) # case to avoid negative rsd
UF_meanRSD_filtered <- 1/(mean_filtered(rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate)) * (1 - rsd_filtered(rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate)))) # derived formula from ISO 10993-18 with mean (filtered 0.05-1)
UF_meanRSD <- 1/(mean(rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate), na.rm = TRUE) * (1 - rsd(rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate)))) # derived formula from ISO 10993-18 with mean
UF_list <- c(
  "UF (2)"   = 2, 
  "UF (4)"   = 4,
  "UF (10)"  = 10, 
  "UF (RSD)" = UF_RSD,

  "UF (RSD filtered)" = UF_RSD_filtered,
  "UF (µRSD filtered)" = UF_meanRSD_filtered,
  "UF (µRSD)" = UF_meanRSD
)

N_extractables <- 80

for (m_name in names(UF_list)) {
  uf_val <- UF_list[[m_name]]
  total_FN <- 0
  total_FP <- 0
  total_TP <- 0
  total_TN <- 0
  
  
for (i in 1:N_sim) {
## 2) Concentration from the log-normal distribution
base_conc_sim <- rlnorm(N_extractables, meanlog = -2.4, sdlog = 4.8)
## A) Sampling from the GC/MS dataset (5µg/mL)
simulated_RRF <- rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate)
## II) UF corrections
  
  exp_conc <- (base_conc_sim * simulated_RRF)
  corrected_conc <- exp_conc * uf_val 
  
  is_at_and_above_threshold <- base_conc_sim >= AET
  reported_at_and_above_threshold <- corrected_conc >= AET

## Count per iteration
  iter_TP <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FP <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FN <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_TN <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)

  total_TP <- total_TP + iter_TP
  total_FP <- total_FP + iter_FP
  total_FN <- total_FN + iter_FN
  total_TN <- total_TN + iter_TN

  # Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC)
  denom_MCC <- sqrt(as.numeric(iter_TP+iter_FP)*(iter_TP+iter_FN)*(iter_TN+iter_FP)*(iter_TN+iter_FN))
  iter_MCC <- if(denom_MCC > 0) ((as.numeric(iter_TP)*iter_TN) - (as.numeric(iter_FP)*iter_FN)) / denom_MCC else 0
  
  # Diagnostic Odds Ratio (DOR)
  iter_DOR <- (as.numeric(iter_TP) * iter_TN) / ((as.numeric(iter_FP) * iter_FN) + 1e-6)
  
  dist_MCC[i] <- iter_MCC
  dist_DOR[i] <- iter_DOR


  # metrics per iterations
  iter_prec <- if((iter_TP + iter_FP) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FP) else 0
  iter_rec  <- if((iter_TP + iter_FN) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FN) else 0
  
  iter_ActualPos <- iter_TP + iter_FN
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP

  iter_fnr <- if(iter_ActualPos > 0) iter_FN / iter_ActualPos else 0
  iter_fpr <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_FP / iter_ActualNeg else 0
  
  dist_fnr[i] <- iter_fnr * 100
  dist_fpr[i] <- iter_fpr * 100
  
  # F1
  iter_f1 <- if((iter_prec + iter_rec) > 0) {
    (2 * iter_prec * iter_rec) / (iter_prec + iter_rec)
  } else { 0 }
  
  # F5
  denom_beta <- (beta^2 * iter_prec) + iter_rec
  iter_fbeta <- if(denom_beta > 0) {
    ((1 + beta^2) * (iter_prec * iter_rec)) / denom_beta
  } else { 0 }
  
  dist_f1[i]   <- iter_f1
  dist_f5[i]   <- iter_fbeta
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP
  iter_Total     <- iter_TP + iter_FP + iter_FN + iter_TN
  iter_spec      <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_TN / iter_ActualNeg else 0}

count_Above_AET <- total_TP + total_FN
count_Below_AET  <- total_TN + total_FP
FN_Rate_final <- total_FN / count_Above_AET
FP_Rate_final <- total_FP / count_Below_AET

recall <- total_TP / count_Above_AET
precision <- total_TP / (total_TP + total_FP)

F1 <- (2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
beta <- 5
f_beta <- (1 + beta^2) * (precision * recall) / ((beta^2 * precision) + recall)

SD_FN <- sqrt(FN_Rate_final * (1 - FN_Rate_final) / count_Above_AET)
SD_FP <- sqrt(FP_Rate_final * (1 - FP_Rate_final) / count_Below_AET)

summary_table <- bind_rows(
  summary_table,
  data.frame(
    Method = m_name,
    FN_Rate = FN_Rate_final,
    FP_Rate = FP_Rate_final,
    FN_SD = SD_FN,
    FP_SD = SD_FP,
    precision = precision,
    recall = recall,
    F1 = F1,
    f_beta = f_beta,MCC = mean(dist_MCC, na.rm = TRUE),
    DOR = mean(dist_DOR, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Absolute Counts and UF
    is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Above_AET,
    X.is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Below_AET,
    reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TP + total_FP,
    X.reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TN + total_FN,
    perc_is_at_and_above_threshold = (count_Above_AET / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    perc_reported_at_and_above_threshold = ((total_TP + total_FP) / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    UF = uf_val
  )
)

metrics_df <- data.frame(
  Method = m_name,
  F1 = dist_f1,
  F5 = dist_f5,
  Percent_FN = dist_fnr,
  Percent_FP = dist_fpr,MCC = dist_MCC,
  DOR = dist_DOR
)

all_distributions <- rbind(all_distributions, metrics_df)

}

UF_RSD

```

## LC-MS Correction Factor mean/16th percentile

```{r}
percentile <- function(x) {
  return(quantile(x, .16))
}

set.seed(123)
N_sim <- 10000
dist_MCC <- numeric(N_sim)
dist_DOR <- numeric(N_sim)
N_extractables <- 80
total_FN <- 0
total_FP <- 0
total_TP <- 0
total_TN <- 0

RRF_LCMS_superior0 <- lcmsneg_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL"
RRF_LCMS_superior0 <- RRF_LCMS_superior0[RRF_LCMS_superior0 > 0]

meanLCMS <- mean(rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate))
percentileLCMS <- percentile(rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate))

for (i in 1:N_sim) {
## 2) Concentration from the log-normal distribution
base_conc_sim <- rlnorm(N_extractables, meanlog = -2.4, sdlog = 4.8)
## A) Sampling from the LC/MS- dataset fitted to gamma dist (5µg/mL – fitted distribution from CLAP list) (5µg/mL)
simulated_RRF <- rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate)

exp_conc <- (base_conc_sim * simulated_RRF)
## III) 16th percentile Correction
corrected_conc <- exp_conc * (meanLCMS / percentileLCMS)

is_at_and_above_threshold <- base_conc_sim >= AET
reported_at_and_above_threshold <- corrected_conc >= AET

## Count per iteration
  iter_TP <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FP <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FN <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_TN <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)

  total_TP <- total_TP + iter_TP
  total_FP <- total_FP + iter_FP
  total_FN <- total_FN + iter_FN
  total_TN <- total_TN + iter_TN

  # Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC)
  denom_MCC <- sqrt(as.numeric(iter_TP+iter_FP)*(iter_TP+iter_FN)*(iter_TN+iter_FP)*(iter_TN+iter_FN))
  iter_MCC <- if(denom_MCC > 0) ((as.numeric(iter_TP)*iter_TN) - (as.numeric(iter_FP)*iter_FN)) / denom_MCC else 0
  
  # Diagnostic Odds Ratio (DOR)
  iter_DOR <- (as.numeric(iter_TP) * iter_TN) / ((as.numeric(iter_FP) * iter_FN) + 1e-6)
  
  dist_MCC[i] <- iter_MCC
  dist_DOR[i] <- iter_DOR


  # metrics per iterations
  iter_prec <- if((iter_TP + iter_FP) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FP) else 0
  iter_rec  <- if((iter_TP + iter_FN) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FN) else 0
  
  iter_ActualPos <- iter_TP + iter_FN
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP

  iter_fnr <- if(iter_ActualPos > 0) iter_FN / iter_ActualPos else 0
  iter_fpr <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_FP / iter_ActualNeg else 0
  
  dist_fnr[i] <- iter_fnr * 100
  dist_fpr[i] <- iter_fpr * 100
  
  # F1
  iter_f1 <- if((iter_prec + iter_rec) > 0) {
    (2 * iter_prec * iter_rec) / (iter_prec + iter_rec)
  } else { 0 }
  
  # F5
  denom_beta <- (beta^2 * iter_prec) + iter_rec
  iter_fbeta <- if(denom_beta > 0) {
    ((1 + beta^2) * (iter_prec * iter_rec)) / denom_beta
  } else { 0 }
  
  dist_f1[i]   <- iter_f1
  dist_f5[i]   <- iter_fbeta
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP
  iter_Total     <- iter_TP + iter_FP + iter_FN + iter_TN
  iter_spec      <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_TN / iter_ActualNeg else 0}

count_Above_AET <- total_TP + total_FN
count_Below_AET  <- total_TN + total_FP
FN_Rate_final <- total_FN / count_Above_AET
FP_Rate_final <- total_FP / count_Below_AET

recall <- total_TP / count_Above_AET
precision <- total_TP / (total_TP + total_FP)

F1 <- (2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
beta <- 5
f_beta <- (1 + beta^2) * (precision * recall) / ((beta^2 * precision) + recall)

SD_FN <- sqrt(FN_Rate_final * (1 - FN_Rate_final) / count_Above_AET)
SD_FP <- sqrt(FP_Rate_final * (1 - FP_Rate_final) / count_Below_AET)

summary_table <- bind_rows(
  summary_table,
  data.frame(
    Method = "µ/Percentile (16th)",
    FN_Rate = FN_Rate_final,
    FP_Rate = FP_Rate_final,
    FN_SD = SD_FN,
    FP_SD = SD_FP,
    precision = precision,
    recall = recall,
    F1 = F1,
    f_beta = f_beta,MCC = mean(dist_MCC, na.rm = TRUE),
    DOR = mean(dist_DOR, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Absolute Counts and UF
    is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Above_AET,
    X.is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Below_AET,
    reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TP + total_FP,
    X.reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TN + total_FN,
    perc_is_at_and_above_threshold = (count_Above_AET / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    perc_reported_at_and_above_threshold = ((total_TP + total_FP) / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    UF = (meanLCMS / percentileLCMS)))

metrics_df <- data.frame(
  Method = "µ/Percentile (16th)",
  F1 = dist_f1,
  F5 = dist_f5,
  Percent_FN = dist_fnr,
  Percent_FP = dist_fpr,MCC = dist_MCC,
  DOR = dist_DOR
)

all_distributions <- rbind(all_distributions, metrics_df)

```

## LC-MS Correction RRFlow

This simulation assumes that we know the true RRF of all compounds sampled and therefore performing the conditional correction. We also force the UF to be positive by removing low and high responders.

```{r}

## RSD is calculated only for RRFs between 0.05 and 1 
## 'Compounds with RRF lower than 0.05 are excluded from UF calculation (20 times lower than the internal standard).page 8
## Therefore, as a criterion for RRF selection, only compounds with an RRF less than 1 are actually considered for UF calculation. page 8

rsd <- function(x) {
  x_use = x[x<=1&x>0.05]
  return(sd(x_use, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(x_use, na.rm = TRUE))
}

## Simulation starts
set.seed(123)
N_sim <- 10000
dist_MCC <- numeric(N_sim)
dist_DOR <- numeric(N_sim)
N_extractables <- 80
total_FN <- 0
total_FP <- 0
total_TP <- 0
total_TN <- 0

# remove 0 values
RRF_LCMS_superior0 <- lcmsneg_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL"
RRF_LCMS_superior0 <- RRF_LCMS_superior0[RRF_LCMS_superior0 > 0]

# Apply Part 18 formula for database
UF <- 1/(1-rsd(rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate)))

# Start simulation
for (i in 1:N_sim) {

## 2) Concentration from the log-normal distribution
base_conc_sim <- rlnorm(N_extractables, meanlog = -2.4, sdlog = 4.8)
## A) Sampling from the GC/MS dataset (5µg/mL)
simulated_RRF <- rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate)
## IV) RRflow condition
## add a normal / lognormal distribution to get a "exp" RRF with some variability e.g 30%
exp_RRF <- simulated_RRF * rnorm(n = N_extractables, 1, 0.3)
exp_conc <- base_conc_sim * simulated_RRF   # experimental concentration : True concentration with the actual RRF
corrected_conc <- exp_conc * UF             # corrected concentration: Exp * UF (conservative method)
condition <- (simulated_RRF < 0.5) | (simulated_RRF > 2) # RRFlow conditions rescaling factor should be focused only to those compounds which exhibits RRF< 0.5 and RRF>2 
corrected_conc[condition] <- exp_conc[condition] / exp_RRF[condition] # average value of the RRF RRFlow application in extractables amount rescaling ( The average RRF determined by the RRFlow will be used to re-calculate the amount of the corresponding compound detected in the extractables study , will assume that it is in the linearity range) 

  is_at_and_above_threshold <- base_conc_sim >= AET
  reported_at_and_above_threshold <- corrected_conc >= AET

## Count per iteration
  iter_TP <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FP <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FN <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_TN <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)

  total_TP <- total_TP + iter_TP
  total_FP <- total_FP + iter_FP
  total_FN <- total_FN + iter_FN
  total_TN <- total_TN + iter_TN

  # Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC)
  denom_MCC <- sqrt(as.numeric(iter_TP+iter_FP)*(iter_TP+iter_FN)*(iter_TN+iter_FP)*(iter_TN+iter_FN))
  iter_MCC <- if(denom_MCC > 0) ((as.numeric(iter_TP)*iter_TN) - (as.numeric(iter_FP)*iter_FN)) / denom_MCC else 0
  
  # Diagnostic Odds Ratio (DOR)
  iter_DOR <- (as.numeric(iter_TP) * iter_TN) / ((as.numeric(iter_FP) * iter_FN) + 1e-6)
  
  dist_MCC[i] <- iter_MCC
  dist_DOR[i] <- iter_DOR


  # metrics per iterations
  iter_prec <- if((iter_TP + iter_FP) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FP) else 0
  iter_rec  <- if((iter_TP + iter_FN) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FN) else 0
  
  iter_ActualPos <- iter_TP + iter_FN
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP

  iter_fnr <- if(iter_ActualPos > 0) iter_FN / iter_ActualPos else 0
  iter_fpr <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_FP / iter_ActualNeg else 0
  
  dist_fnr[i] <- iter_fnr * 100
  dist_fpr[i] <- iter_fpr * 100
  
  # F1
  iter_f1 <- if((iter_prec + iter_rec) > 0) {
    (2 * iter_prec * iter_rec) / (iter_prec + iter_rec)
  } else { 0 }
  
  # F5
  denom_beta <- (beta^2 * iter_prec) + iter_rec
  iter_fbeta <- if(denom_beta > 0) {
    ((1 + beta^2) * (iter_prec * iter_rec)) / denom_beta
  } else { 0 }
  
  dist_f1[i]   <- iter_f1
  dist_f5[i]   <- iter_fbeta
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP
  iter_Total     <- iter_TP + iter_FP + iter_FN + iter_TN
  iter_spec      <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_TN / iter_ActualNeg else 0}

count_Above_AET <- total_TP + total_FN
count_Below_AET  <- total_TN + total_FP
FN_Rate_final <- total_FN / count_Above_AET
FP_Rate_final <- total_FP / count_Below_AET

recall <- total_TP / count_Above_AET
precision <- total_TP / (total_TP + total_FP)

F1 <- (2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
beta <- 5
f_beta <- (1 + beta^2) * (precision * recall) / ((beta^2 * precision) + recall)

SD_FN <- sqrt(FN_Rate_final * (1 - FN_Rate_final) / count_Above_AET)
SD_FP <- sqrt(FP_Rate_final * (1 - FP_Rate_final) / count_Below_AET)

summary_table <- bind_rows(
  summary_table,
  data.frame(
    Method = "RRFlow",
    FN_Rate = FN_Rate_final,
    FP_Rate = FP_Rate_final,
    FN_SD = SD_FN,
    FP_SD = SD_FP,
    precision = precision,
    recall = recall,
    F1 = F1,
    f_beta = f_beta,MCC = mean(dist_MCC, na.rm = TRUE),
    DOR = mean(dist_DOR, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Absolute Counts and UF
    is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Above_AET,
    X.is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Below_AET,
    reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TP + total_FP,
    X.reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TN + total_FN,
    perc_is_at_and_above_threshold = (count_Above_AET / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    perc_reported_at_and_above_threshold = ((total_TP + total_FP) / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    UF = 1/(1-rsd(rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate)))
  )
)

metrics_df <- data.frame(
  Method = "RRFlow",
  F1 = dist_f1,
  F5 = dist_f5,
  Percent_FN = dist_fnr,
  Percent_FP = dist_fpr,MCC = dist_MCC,
  DOR = dist_DOR
)

all_distributions <- rbind(all_distributions, metrics_df)

```

```{r}
N_extractables <- 80
total_FN <- 0
total_FP <- 0
total_TP <- 0
total_TN <- 0

conservative_RRF_estimate <- quantile(rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate), 0.20)

for (i in 1:N_sim) {

## 2) Concentration from the log-normal distribution
base_conc_sim <- rlnorm(N_extractables, meanlog = -2.4, sdlog = 4.8)
## A) Non-Parametric Bootstrap of the GC/MS dataset (5µg/mL)
simulated_RRF <- rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate)
## V 

exp_conc <- base_conc_sim * simulated_RRF   # experimental concentration : True concentration with the actual RRF
corrected_conc <- exp_conc / conservative_RRF_estimate ## need to find rationale

is_at_and_above_threshold <- base_conc_sim >= AET
reported_at_and_above_threshold <- corrected_conc >= AET

## Count per iteration
  iter_TP <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FP <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FN <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_TN <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)

  total_TP <- total_TP + iter_TP
  total_FP <- total_FP + iter_FP
  total_FN <- total_FN + iter_FN
  total_TN <- total_TN + iter_TN

  # Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC)
  denom_MCC <- sqrt(as.numeric(iter_TP+iter_FP)*(iter_TP+iter_FN)*(iter_TN+iter_FP)*(iter_TN+iter_FN))
  iter_MCC <- if(denom_MCC > 0) ((as.numeric(iter_TP)*iter_TN) - (as.numeric(iter_FP)*iter_FN)) / denom_MCC else 0
  
  # Diagnostic Odds Ratio (DOR)
  iter_DOR <- (as.numeric(iter_TP) * iter_TN) / ((as.numeric(iter_FP) * iter_FN) + 1e-6)
  
  dist_MCC[i] <- iter_MCC
  dist_DOR[i] <- iter_DOR


  # metrics per iterations
  iter_prec <- if((iter_TP + iter_FP) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FP) else 0
  iter_rec  <- if((iter_TP + iter_FN) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FN) else 0
  
  iter_ActualPos <- iter_TP + iter_FN
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP

  iter_fnr <- if(iter_ActualPos > 0) iter_FN / iter_ActualPos else 0
  iter_fpr <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_FP / iter_ActualNeg else 0
  
  dist_fnr[i] <- iter_fnr * 100
  dist_fpr[i] <- iter_fpr * 100
  
  # F1
  iter_f1 <- if((iter_prec + iter_rec) > 0) {
    (2 * iter_prec * iter_rec) / (iter_prec + iter_rec)
  } else { 0 }
  
  # F5
  denom_beta <- (beta^2 * iter_prec) + iter_rec
  iter_fbeta <- if(denom_beta > 0) {
    ((1 + beta^2) * (iter_prec * iter_rec)) / denom_beta
  } else { 0 }
  
  dist_f1[i]   <- iter_f1
  dist_f5[i]   <- iter_fbeta
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP
  iter_Total     <- iter_TP + iter_FP + iter_FN + iter_TN
  iter_spec      <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_TN / iter_ActualNeg else 0}

count_Above_AET <- total_TP + total_FN
count_Below_AET  <- total_TN + total_FP
FN_Rate_final <- total_FN / count_Above_AET
FP_Rate_final <- total_FP / count_Below_AET

recall <- total_TP / count_Above_AET
precision <- total_TP / (total_TP + total_FP)

F1 <- (2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
beta <- 5
f_beta <- (1 + beta^2) * (precision * recall) / ((beta^2 * precision) + recall)

SD_FN <- sqrt(FN_Rate_final * (1 - FN_Rate_final) / count_Above_AET)
SD_FP <- sqrt(FP_Rate_final * (1 - FP_Rate_final) / count_Below_AET)

summary_table <- bind_rows(
  summary_table,
  data.frame(
    Method = "Percentile 20th",
    FN_Rate = FN_Rate_final,
    FP_Rate = FP_Rate_final,
    FN_SD = SD_FN,
    FP_SD = SD_FP,
    precision = precision,
    recall = recall,
    F1 = F1,
    f_beta = f_beta,MCC = mean(dist_MCC, na.rm = TRUE),
    DOR = mean(dist_DOR, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Absolute Counts and UF
    is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Above_AET,
    X.is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Below_AET,
    reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TP + total_FP,
    X.reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TN + total_FN,
    perc_is_at_and_above_threshold = (count_Above_AET / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    perc_reported_at_and_above_threshold = ((total_TP + total_FP) / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    UF = 1 / conservative_RRF_estimate
  )
)

metrics_df <- data.frame(
  Method = "Percentile 20th",
  F1 = dist_f1,
  F5 = dist_f5,
  Percent_FN = dist_fnr,
  Percent_FP = dist_fpr,MCC = dist_MCC,
  DOR = dist_DOR
)

all_distributions <- rbind(all_distributions, metrics_df)
```

# Comparisons

```{r}
plot_data <- summary_table %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(FN_Rate, FP_Rate), names_to = "Type", values_to = "Rate") %>%
  mutate(
    SD = ifelse(Type == "FN_Rate", round(FN_SD*100, 2), round(FP_SD*100, 2)),
    Type = ifelse(Type == "FN_Rate", "False Negative", "False Positive")
  )

method_levels <- c(
  "No Correction",
  "UF (2)",
  "UF (4)",
  "UF (10)",
  "UF (RSD)",
  "UF (RSD filtered)",
  "UF (µRSD)",
  "UF (µRSD filtered)",
  "µ/Percentile (16th)",
  "Percentile 10th",
  "Percentile 20th",
  "RRFlow",
  "RRF<1",
  "Machine Learning"
)

plot_data$Method <- factor(plot_data$Method, levels = method_levels)


ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Method, y = Rate*100, fill = Type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(0, Rate*100 - 1.96*SD), ymax = Rate*100 + 1.96*SD), 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.2) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Comparison of LC-MS neg Correction Methods (5 µg/mL)", " AET=", AET, "µg/mL"),
    subtitle = "Conc. from Log/Normal Distribution, RRF sampled from fitted dist",
    y = "Rate (%)",
    x = "Method") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Rate*100)), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), hjust = -0.5, size = 3, vjust = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("False Negative" = "red", "False Positive" = "grey")) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_flip()
```

```{r}
                   size = 3, fontface = "bold", max.overlaps = Inf) +
  labs(
    title = "Discriminative Power (DOR) vs. Reliability (MCC)",
    subtitle = "DOR is shown on a Log10 scale | High values in both axes represent superior RRF correction",
    x = "Log10(Diagnostic Odds Ratio)",
    y = "Matthews Correlation Coefficient"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# Confusion Matrices (Average over 10,000 Simulations)

```{r}
# 4-column method ordering (groups: fixed-UF | RSD-UF | Percentile | RRF/ML)
method_levels_4col <- c(
  "No Correction",
  "UF (2)",
  "UF (4)",
  "UF (10)",
  "UF (RSD)",
  "UF (RSD filtered)",
  "UF (µRSD)",
  "UF (µRSD filtered)",
  "µ/Percentile (16th)",
  "Percentile 10th",
  "Percentile 20th",
  "RRFlow",
  "RRF<1",
  "Machine Learning"
)

N_sim <- 10000

# ── Reconstruct cell counts from cumulated summary_table columns ──────────────
# Column guide (sums over N_sim iterations):
#   is_at_and_above_threshold        = total_TP + total_FN  (all actual positives)
#   X.is_at_and_above_threshold      = total_TN + total_FP  (all actual negatives)
#   reported_at_and_above_threshold  = total_TP + total_FP  (all predicted positives)
#   recall                           = total_TP / actual_positives
cm_data <- summary_table %>%
  mutate(
    total_grand = is_at_and_above_threshold + X.is_at_and_above_threshold,
    TP = recall * is_at_and_above_threshold,
    FN = is_at_and_above_threshold - TP,
    FP = reported_at_and_above_threshold - TP,
    TN = X.is_at_and_above_threshold - FP,
    # Percentage of grand total
    pct_TP = round(TP / total_grand * 100, 1),
    pct_FP = round(FP / total_grand * 100, 1),
    pct_FN = round(FN / total_grand * 100, 1),
    pct_TN = round(TN / total_grand * 100, 1),
    # Average count per simulation (out of 80 compounds)
    avg_TP = round(TP / N_sim),
    avg_FP = round(FP / N_sim),
    avg_FN = round(FN / N_sim),
    avg_TN = round(TN / N_sim)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Method, pct_TP, pct_FP, pct_FN, pct_TN,
                         avg_TP, avg_FP, avg_FN, avg_TN)

# ── Per-iteration SD from all_distributions ───────────────────────────────────
cm_sd_base <- all_distributions %>%
  left_join(
    summary_table %>%
      transmute(
        Method,
        total_grand_per_sim = (is_at_and_above_threshold + X.is_at_and_above_threshold) / N_sim,
        actual_pos_frac     = is_at_and_above_threshold /
          (is_at_and_above_threshold + X.is_at_and_above_threshold),
        actual_neg_frac     = X.is_at_and_above_threshold /
          (is_at_and_above_threshold + X.is_at_and_above_threshold),
        actual_pos_per_sim  = is_at_and_above_threshold / N_sim,
        actual_neg_per_sim  = X.is_at_and_above_threshold / N_sim
      ),
    by = "Method"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Per-iteration FN / FP / TP / TN as % of grand total
    sim_pct_FN = (Percent_FN / 100) * actual_pos_frac * 100,
    sim_pct_FP = (Percent_FP / 100) * actual_neg_frac * 100,
    sim_pct_TP = actual_pos_frac * 100 - sim_pct_FN,
    sim_pct_TN = actual_neg_frac * 100 - sim_pct_FP,
    # Per-iteration FN / FP / TP / TN as counts (out of 80)
    sim_FN = (Percent_FN / 100) * actual_pos_per_sim,
    sim_FP = (Percent_FP / 100) * actual_neg_per_sim,
    sim_TP = actual_pos_per_sim - sim_FN,
    sim_TN = actual_neg_per_sim - sim_FP
  ) %>%
  group_by(Method) %>%
  summarize(
    # % SDs
    sd_pct_TP = round(sd(sim_pct_TP, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_pct_FP = round(sd(sim_pct_FP, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_pct_FN = round(sd(sim_pct_FN, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_pct_TN = round(sd(sim_pct_TN, na.rm = TRUE)),
    # Count SDs
    sd_avg_TP = round(sd(sim_TP, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_avg_FP = round(sd(sim_FP, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_avg_FN = round(sd(sim_FN, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_avg_TN = round(sd(sim_TN, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

# ── Shared ggplot2 objects (defined early so they survive chunk-2 errors) ─────
cm_tile_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        axis.text       = element_text(size = 9),
        panel.grid      = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
        plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"))

cm_fill_scale <- scale_fill_manual(
  values = c("TP" = "#2E86AB", "TN" = "#2E86AB",
             "FN" = "#E84855", "FP" = "#F4A261"),
  guide = guide_legend(title = "Cell type")
)
```

```{r}
# ── Percentage confusion matrix (mean ± SD %) ─────────────────────────────────
cm_long_pct <- cm_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Method, pct_TP, pct_FP, pct_FN, pct_TN) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pct_TP, pct_FP, pct_FN, pct_TN),
               names_to = "Cell", values_to = "Pct") %>%
  left_join(
    cm_sd_base %>%
      dplyr::select(Method, sd_pct_TP, sd_pct_FP, sd_pct_FN, sd_pct_TN) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = c(sd_pct_TP, sd_pct_FP, sd_pct_FN, sd_pct_TN),
                   names_to = "Cell_sd", values_to = "SD") %>%
      mutate(Cell = sub("sd_pct_", "pct_", Cell_sd)) %>%
      dplyr::select(Method, Cell, SD),
    by = c("Method", "Cell")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Predicted = case_when(Cell %in% c("pct_TP", "pct_FP") ~ "Positive",
                          TRUE ~ "Negative"),
    Actual    = case_when(Cell %in% c("pct_TP", "pct_FN") ~ "Positive",
                          TRUE ~ "Negative"),
    CellType  = toupper(sub("pct_", "", Cell)),
    Label     = paste0(Pct, "%±", SD, "%"),
    Predicted = factor(Predicted, levels = c("Positive", "Negative")),
    Actual    = factor(Actual,    levels = c("Positive", "Negative"))
  )

cm_long_pct$Method <- factor(cm_long_pct$Method, levels = method_levels)

# 3-column
ggplot(cm_long_pct, aes(x = Predicted, y = Actual, fill = CellType)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label), size = 3.8, fontface = "bold",
            color = "white", lineheight = 0.9) +
  cm_fill_scale +
  facet_wrap(~ Method, ncol = 3) +
  labs(title    = "Confusion Matrix per Correction Method — mean \u00b1 SD (%)",
       subtitle = paste0("Mean \u00b1 SD over 10,000 simulations | AET = ", AET, " \u00b5g/mL"),
       x = "Predicted class (reported vs AET)",
       y = "Actual class (true vs AET)") +
  cm_tile_theme

# 4-column
cm_long_pct_4col <- cm_long_pct
cm_long_pct_4col$Method <- factor(cm_long_pct_4col$Method, levels = method_levels_4col)

ggplot(cm_long_pct_4col, aes(x = Predicted, y = Actual, fill = CellType)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label), size = 3.8, fontface = "bold",
            color = "white", lineheight = 0.9) +
  cm_fill_scale +
  facet_wrap(~ Method, ncol = 4) +
  labs(title    = "Confusion Matrix per Correction Method — mean \u00b1 SD (%)",
       subtitle = paste0("Mean \u00b1 SD over 10,000 simulations | AET = ", AET, " \u00b5g/mL"),
       x = "Predicted class (reported vs AET)",
       y = "Actual class (true vs AET)") +
  cm_tile_theme
```
